project.name: Supplier Payment Fraud Triage Agent
project.objective: Agent that triages supplier bank-change emails (approve / hold-and-verify / reject) under uncertainty over legitimate / spoofed / compromised mailbox, India setting

lifecycle.next_action: Create requirement-linked implementation tasks with executable gates, then run genesis plan check.

approval.reason: Approved by Manish in chat on 2026-10-06 ("approve"); no reason given beyond approval

assumptions.text: Callback delay (time from request to failed callback) is unknown; p2 depends on it. Until practitioner answers arrive it is an assumed setting varied in a sensitivity check.
Prior over the 3 states has no clean source (most reports lack the total of requests; investigator data may over-count compromised). Use a range, values labelled assumed, and a sensitivity check.
Evidence likelihood directions (9-clue table) are the student's judgment, not yet sourced.

decisions.title: Three separate hidden states
decisions.text: Hidden states are legitimate / spoofed / compromised real mailbox. Spoofed and compromised stay separate because they lead to different best actions (reject only adds value when compromised).

decisions.title: Reject means block plus security alert
decisions.text: Reject = the email is blocked before the AP inbox and a security alert is logged. A wrong reject is recoverable: security can review and release the email.

decisions.title: Setting is India
decisions.text: Payments by NEFT/RTGS/IMPS, accounts identified by IFSC, amounts in INR, penny-drop name check available.

decisions.title: Three-zone policy and derived p1
decisions.text: Approve below p1, hold-and-verify between p1 and p2, reject above p2. p1 = cost of one verification / loss if fraud approved; very small and falls as the amount rises. p2 depends mainly on P(compromised).

decisions.title: Failed callback raises a security alert
decisions.text: If the supplier says on callback that they never sent the request, a security alert is raised (option B). A call shows fraud but not which kind. Consequence: reject's only remaining advantage over hold is timing (alerts immediately vs after the call fails).

decisions.title: Accepted r/Accounting design changes
decisions.text: IFSC branch mismatch is evidence; logo and signature are near-uninformative; the experiment includes an always hold-and-verify baseline.

decisions.title: Supplier change history belongs in the prior
decisions.text: Supplier change history is known before the email arrives, so it makes the L2 prior supplier-specific rather than acting as L3 evidence.

decisions.title: Clues independent within each world
decisions.text: For the first version, clues are treated as independent given the hidden world (naive Bayes). Known to be false for lookalike domain + SPF/DKIM; reported as a limitation.

decisions.title: Beating always-call is reported, not required
decisions.text: Acceptance requires the results to state whether and when the agent beats always hold-and-verify; winning is not required, to avoid tuning numbers until it wins.
